problem: Unit was active but last checkpoint/pose write stopped at about 19:30:50, 44.5 km. Earlier status quoted stale checkpoint data as if progressing; this was corrected explicitly.
action: Changed ONLY the live MemoryHigh from 6 GiB to 7 GiB, equal to the existing hard ceiling. The un-reclaimable anonymous working set had exceeded the old soft target while swap was disabled.
permanent_changes: Guarded launcher now uses MemoryHigh=7G and the SAME MemoryMax=7G/MemorySwapMax=0.
Read-only status utility checks final metrics, complete 5 Hz CSV rows and file freshness; active/success alone cannot establish progress or completion.
boundaries: Hard resource limits do not protect against unrelated applications exhausting the host. A stale-progress warning may mean a deliberate pause or a long operation, so it never automatically kills or restarts a task.
